props.title: What Is a Body Scrub?
props.text: Body scrub is an exfoliating treatment to remove dead skin cells, lift daily buildup, and help restore smoother skin texture. In Bali, sun exposure, saltwater, humidity, and outdoor activities can leave the skin feeling dry or dull over time. Our therapists use natural exfoliants inspired by traditional Balinese lulur rituals to gently refresh the skin while creating a relaxing treatment experience.
props.feature1Text: Available in chocolate, coconut, strawberry, bengkoang, jasmine, green tea, and Spa Sari variants.
props.feature2Text: Comfortable exfoliation using fine natural scrub ingredients and controlled pressure.

props.title: Body Scrub Packages in Seminyak
props.text: Body scrubs are often combined with massage, facials, and beauty treatments to create a complete wellness session. Our packages are designed for guests looking to refresh both body and mind while enjoying their time in Bali.

props.title: Body Scrub Options
props.text: Our Body Scrub is available in a selection of natural-inspired variants, so you can enjoy the same full-body exfoliating treatment with the fragrance and blend you prefer. An additional body mask can be applied after the scrub and followed by a shower.

props.title: When to Book a Body Scrub
props.text: There is no single best time to use a body scrub. It depends on your skin condition, daily activities, and spa routine. A body scrub may be especially suitable:
featuresLeft: When your skin feels rough or dull
featuresRight: As part of your regular skincare routine

props.title: Body Scrub Benefits
props.text: Many guests choose body scrubs after beach days, outdoor activities, or before special occasions. A regular body scrub can help refresh the skin and support a smoother feel by:
featuresLeft: Helps remove dead skin cells and buildup
May improve the appearance of dry areas
featuresRight: Allows moisturizers and body oils to absorb more effectively
Helps maintain softer and brighter-looking skin
Commonly chosen before holidays and special events

props.title: Choose Your Natural Scrub
props.text: Each scrub ingredient creates a slightly different treatment experience while delivering the same gentle exfoliating effect. The choice often comes down to fragrance preferences and the type of skin support you are looking for.
featuresLeft: Chocolate for a rich nourishing experience
featuresRight: Green Tea for a calming treatment
Jasmine and Spa Sari for a traditional aromatic experience

props.title: What Happens During Your Body Scrub
props.text: The treatment begins with your choice of scrub ingredients before gentle circular massage movements are used to exfoliate the body evenly. Additional attention is often given to rougher areas such as elbows, knees, and feet before the scrub is removed to reveal smoother and cleaner-feeling skin underneath. The same treatment experience is also available through our villa and hotel home service appointments.
featuresRight: Available for spa and home service bookings

items.question: What happens during a body scrub massage?
items.answer: During a body scrub massage at Spa Bali Moon, your therapist applies your chosen natural scrub with gentle circular motions to remove dead skin cells and stimulate circulation, often giving extra attention to elbows, knees and feet. After rinsing, it may be followed by a moisturising lotion, body oil or relaxing massage.

items.question: What are the benefits of a full body scrub?
items.answer: A full body scrub at Spa Bali Moon helps remove dead skin cells from the skin's surface, leaving it smoother, softer and refreshed. Regular exfoliation can improve skin texture, promote a brighter appearance and help moisturisers absorb more effectively. Other benefits may include improved circulation, less rough or dry skin and a cleaner, healthier-looking complexion.

items.question: How often should I get a body scrub treatment?
items.answer: Most guests choose a body scrub every one to two weeks to help maintain smooth skin and support natural skin renewal cycles. In Bali, many also book one after beach days or before a special occasion. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, a body scrub is IDR 169.000 per person in any of seven scents.

items.question: Will the scrub feel rough on my skin?
items.answer: No. Spa Bali Moon's body scrub uses fine natural exfoliants inspired by traditional Balinese lulur, applied with gentle circular movements and controlled pressure, so the treatment stays comfortable while still exfoliating effectively. Choose from seven scents, including coconut, jasmine and green tea, for IDR 169.000 per person at our Seminyak spa or your villa or hotel.

items.question: Is body scrub suitable for dry skin?
items.answer: Yes. A body scrub removes dead surface buildup, which often allows moisturisers and body oils to absorb more effectively, helping dry skin feel softer and more hydrated afterwards. At Spa Bali Moon, the coconut scrub is a good choice for moisture and softness, and an additional body mask can be added for IDR 100.000.

items.question: Can I get a body scrub after spending time in the sun?
items.answer: Yes, a body scrub is fine after sun, provided your skin is not sunburned or overly sensitive. Many guests book one at Spa Bali Moon after beach days or outdoor activities to remove buildup and refresh skin left dry or dull by sun and salt water. It costs IDR 169.000 per person.

items.question: Can body scrubs help with body acne or clogged pores?
items.answer: Possibly, for clogged pores. Regular exfoliation with a body scrub may help reduce the buildup of dead skin cells and impurities that can contribute to clogged pores. It is not a medical treatment for acne, but many guests at Spa Bali Moon find their skin feels cleaner and smoother after regular treatments.

items.question: How much does a body scrub cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: A body scrub at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak is IDR 169.000 per person, whichever of the seven scents you choose. An additional body mask is IDR 100.000. Four packages from IDR 439.000 per person add a massage, facial, hot stone or cream bath. Home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: Where can I get a body scrub in Seminyak?
items.answer: You can get a body scrub at Spa Bali Moon, Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30, Seminyak, open daily from 9am to 11pm, or at your villa or hotel for an extra IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. It is IDR 169.000 per person in any of seven scents. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144.

items.question: How long does a body scrub take?
items.answer: A body scrub at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes around an hour and costs IDR 169.000 per person, in any of seven scents. In a spa package the scrub is a shorter 30-minute version.

items.question: Can I have a body scrub at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen and everything a body scrub needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book a body scrub for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your body scrub on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
